results.note: Inverted file-existence guard: reads proceed only when the file is absent, so real Market/Cargo/Status files are skipped and missing ones are read.
Inverted type check: valid dict payloads are now rejected (return None) while non-dict payloads fall through to _archive/return.
Swapped dict keys between branches: market_json archives get the (missing) Vessel key as subject and vice versa, so subject is wrong/None.
Comparison flip: commander/FID are updated on every event except LoadGame, instead of only on LoadGame.
or->and: effectively clears commander on first LoadGame.
Wrong dict key: capi_market subject lookup reads 'name' instead of 'id'.
or->and: an endpoint that exactly equals a known path no longer matches, so exact-path CAPI responses are never archived.
Wrong dict key: capi_profile subject now reads commander id instead of commander name.
Swapped arguments: raw bytes and parsed data are passed in the wrong positions.
Inverted guard: archiving is skipped whenever the guard var is unset and proceeds only when it is set.
or->and: the stored observed_at becomes the recording stamp when the payload carried its own timestamp, and None when it did not.
or->and applied to the projection timestamp.
